sources.title: ESMC Protein Language Model | Biohub Platform
sources.snippet: ESMC ESMC is the latest in the ESM family of protein language models, establishing a new frontier in representation learning for protein biology. Trained on billions of evolutionary sequences, it learns representations that reflect a mechanistic reduction of protein structure and function.
